snippet.title: Butcher's Blasphemy | Marvel Rivals Season 10 Trailer | Marvel Rivals
snippet.description:
Even the gods can die. ☠️  

After wielding the power of All-Black the Necrosword against the would-be gods of Thebes, the God Butcher's dark crusade brings him to Yggsgard.   

As long as gods existed, mortals would be shackled to illusions and useless prayers instead of believing in themselves. His mission was clear: assemble the God Bomb and obliterate all things divine.  

But the King of Yggsgard stands at the ready to defend his kingdom, the sound of thunder close behind him. Will they be enough to save the heavens from true mortal vengeance?  

📅  Season 10: Butcher's Blasphemy unfolds on September 11 (UTC). Gorr has come. 🔪
